label: Ignatius of Antioch addresses the church at Ephesus

date.note: Ignatius wrote en route to martyrdom at Rome. Eusebius (Hist. eccl. 3.36) places the journey under Trajan (reigned 98–117), traditionally c. 107–110; the range brackets the later part of Trajan's reign. A minority redates the letters to c. 125–150 (Barnes 2008).

primary.cite: Ignatius, To the Ephesians, salutation; also 1.3, 6.2 (their bishop Onesimus)

secondary.cite: Harnack, Mission and Expansion, vol. 2, pp. 185–186

notes: One of the seven authentic (middle-recension) letters. Independent of the Apocalypse's letter to Ephesus (lit-apocalypse-ephesus) and ~15 years later; both attesting the same church is intended. Ignatius names Onesimus as their bishop.
